questions.question: The calendar for the year 2011 will be the same as which of the following years?
questions.solution:
The given year is 2011, which is an Ordinary Year.

We need to count the odd days starting from 2011 until the sum is a multiple of 7:

__
 
• 2011: 1 odd day
 
• 2012: 2 odd days (Leap Year)
 
• 2013: 1 odd day
 
• 2014: 1 odd day
 
• 2015: 1 odd day
 
• 2016: 2 odd days (Leap Year)
 
• 2017: 1 odd day
 
• 2018: 1 odd day
 
• 2019: 1 odd day
 
• 2020: 2 odd days (Leap Year)
 
• 2021: 1 odd day

Sum of odd days = 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 14 odd days.

Since 14 is divisible by 7 (14 ÷ 7 = 2, with 0 remainder), the next year, 2022, will have the same calendar as 2011.

Both 2011 and 2022 are Ordinary Years, so the calendars are identical.

The calendar for the year 2011 will be the same as 2022.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__****
There is a specific pattern for the repetition of calendars:

 
• If the year is Leap year + 1, the calendar repeats after 6 years.
 
• If the year is Leap year + 2, the calendar repeats after 11 years.
 
• If the year is Leap year + 3, the calendar repeats after 11 years.
 
• If the year is a Leap year, the calendar repeats after 28 years.

The year 2011 follows the Leap year + 3 rule (as 2008 was a Leap year):

2011 = 2008 + 3

Repetition interval = 11 years.

Repeating year = 2011 + 11 = 2022.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.

questions.question: In the following options, which word can be formed from the letters of the word 'CONGRATULATIONS'?
questions.solution:
**Given word: CONGRATULATIONS**

**(1) GROAN → Can be formed as all the letters (G, R, O, A, N) are present in the given word.**

(2) CONSENT → Can not be formed as it requires the letter "E", which is not present in the given word.

(3) UNIFORM → Can not be formed as it requires the letters "F" and "M", which are not present in the given word.

(4) RENT → Can not be formed as it requires the letter "E", which is not present in the given word.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: Find the missing number in the series. 325, 340, 355, 370, ?
questions.solution:

340 + 15 = 355

355 + 15 = 370

**370 + 15 = 385**

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.

questions.question: Find the missing number in the series. 601, 597, 589, 577, ?
questions.solution:

601 - 4 = 597

597 - 8 = 589

589 - 12 = 577

**577 - 16 = 561**

**4543 : ?**

⇒ 4543 − 50 = 4493.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and fifth number is related to sixth number. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

347 : 685 :: ? : 1903 :: 610 : 1211
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Second Number = (First Number × 2) − 9**

For the first pair **347 : 685**

⇒ (347 × 2) − 9

⇒ 694 − 9 = 685.

For the third pair **610 : 1211**

⇒ (610 × 2) − 9

⇒ 1220 − 9 = 1211.

Applying the same logic to the second pair **? : 1903**

⇒ (Missing Number × 2) − 9 = 1903

⇒ Missing Number × 2 = 1903 + 9

⇒ Missing Number × 2 = 1912

⇒ Missing Number = 1912 ÷ 2 = 956.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

questions.question: A clock is 6 minutes slow at 2:20 PM and 12 minutes slow at 8:20 PM. At what time (in AM) will it show the correct time?
questions.solution:
Time interval from 2:20 PM to 8:20 PM = 6 hours.

Initial error at 2:20 PM = 6 minutes slow.

Final error at 8:20 PM = 12 minutes slow.

Total time lost during this interval = 12 minutes − 6 minutes = 6 minutes.

Rate of losing time = 6 minutes ÷ 6 hours = 1 minute per hour.

Time taken to lose 6 minutes = 6 minutes ÷ 1 minute/hour = 6 hours.

Correct time = 2:20 PM − 6 hours = 8:20 AM.

Hence, the clock shows the correct time at 8:20 AM.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
